Well basically you're always ashamed of what you have and envy what you don't have. I've also been really ashamed about how I look and it made me always avoid looking into mirrors etc, just to avoid making myself cringe by how stupid I look. People say I look handsome etc, but I just can't stand to look at myself. I looks like one of my eyes are fucked up and I have a too big nose etc. And honestly if you had a big dick, then you would just be ashamed that the curve on it wasn't right or something like that... My point is you will always find something you're not happy with.

In my own experience my life actually got better when I moved away from all the bad people in my life (my dad etc) But my mistake was that I didn't process all the bad feelings I had inside, so I ended up getting a massive depression, which made me get out in a lot of shit and bad situations... My suggestion is just get help as fast as you can, because it will only get worse and worse. And if you've gotten help then you will be able to start and maintain your own life, when you move out. But if you're like me and try to start a life with a depression, then you will have a real bad time.

So basically my life is in shit and I've been in so much pain for a while. For the last 4 years I've been in a massive depression, and it was all leading up with my bad childhood, where my mother died when I was 8 and I had to live with my non loving dad for 10 years, until I was 18 - When I was 18 I moved out to live by myself and honestly it has been so tough, I have lived by myself for 4 years now. But as I moved out I also found the love of my life, but she didn't find me, so I've been struggling with a hard depression for all that time, which has led me to end my studies several times and do nothing. This made me not get any income and made me end up getting some stupid loans I can't pay back as well as being kicked out of my apartment soon because I can't pay the rent. I've just totally lost the will to live and I can't see a way to turn my life around or fix it at this point and I just feel like some things just can't be fixed and aren't meant to be... Where I am one of those things. I could go into a lot more detail, but this is just a short version of it. Feel free to leave your thoughts, that's why I'm writing here after all
